functions.get_item(sku): returns dict {sku:str, name:str, price:float dollars, category:str} or None
functions.get_customer(customer_id): returns dict {id:str, name:str, discount:float fraction (10% -> 0.10), region:str} or None
functions.all_items(): returns list of item dicts (same shape as get_item)
functions.all_customers(): returns list of customer dicts (same shape as get_customer)

value.notes: Money in dollars as float; percentages as fractions; not-found returns None. Data loaded from data_pricing/ relative to pricing.py. Lookups are exact-match on sku/customer id.

why: Shared pricing API proposal from pricing developer

pricing.get_unit_price: get_unit_price(sku: str) -> Decimal, Decimal(0) if unknown
pricing.get_customer_name: get_customer_name(customer_id: str) -> str, empty string if unknown
pricing.get_discount_multiplier: get_discount_multiplier(customer_id: str) -> Decimal, 0.90 for 10% off, Decimal(1) if unknown (exception to default-0: 0 would mean 100% off)

tax.get_tax: get_tax(customer_id: str, lines: list[tuple[str, Decimal]]) -> tuple[Decimal, Decimal]; lines = (sku, net amount after discount, 2dp, sum equals subtotal - discount); returns (tax_amount rounded to cent half-up, tax_multiplier e.g. 1.0825; Decimal(1) if no tax). tax.py decides taxability per sku.

value.rounding: discount = subtotal*(1-discount_multiplier) quantized to cent ROUND_HALF_UP; discount allocated to lines by largest remainder so line nets sum exactly to subtotal-discount

why: Interface for render_invoice; tax base depends on per-line taxability (example: tax 1.86 = 8.25% of A net 22.50, D exempt)
Superseded: adopting agent1's pricing_api; re-proposing tax part as tax_api

functions.get_tax(customer_id, lines): lines: list of (sku: str, net_amount: Decimal) where net_amount = line amount after the invoice discount, 2dp, all lines sum to subtotal - discount. Returns (tax_amount: Decimal rounded to cent ROUND_HALF_UP, tax_rate: Decimal multiplier e.g. Decimal("1.0825") for 8.25%; Decimal("1") if no tax). Unknown customer -> (Decimal("0.00"), Decimal("1")). tax.py alone decides which skus are taxable.

value.notes: Money as Decimal in dollars (team standard). Caller (invoice.py) shows tax percent as (tax_rate-1)*100 without trailing zeros. Pricing side uses pricing_api as agreed; invoice.py converts float prices/discount fractions.

why: Tax base depends on per-sku taxability (example: tax 1.86 = 8.25% of A net 22.50, D exempt). Tax API needs line-level nets.
invoice.py uses pricing.get_item / get_customer as specified
